definitions.explanation: Matching certain conditions, criteria, or categories. Used when something fits or applies to a particular case, rule, or description.

examples.japanese: {該当|がいとう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{項目|こうもく}→項目：04150_koumoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んで→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{該当|がいとう}{者|しゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{通知|つうち}します→通知する：19645_tsuuchisuru⟧。
examples.english: Those who qualify will be notified by email.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{該当|がいとう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}→申請：04207_shinsei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
examples.english: If you fall under these conditions, an application is required.

notes:
USAGE:
{該当|がいとう} is a formal word commonly found in administrative documents, forms, legal texts, and official instructions. It indicates that something matches or fits certain criteria. The expression {該当|がいとう}なし (not applicable, N/A) is extremely common on forms. It is a homophone of ⟦{街灯|がいとう}→街灯：14025_gaitou⟧ (street light), which has a completely different meaning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {該当|がいとう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be applicable, to correspond
- {該当|がいとう}{者|しゃ}: person who qualifies, eligible person
- {該当|がいとう}なし: not applicable (N/A)
- {該当|がいとう}⟦{箇所|かしょ}→箇所：00196_kasho⟧: applicable section/part
